profile_text.body:
Ericsson is a Stockholm-based public company, listed under the ticker ERIC, that describes itself as powering the networks that connect billions. Per its own site, it works across 5G, AI-driven automation, cloud, and enterprise connectivity, and it says it helps providers and enterprises unlock what connectivity can do. Its site also discusses 6G as a future "intelligent fabric" connecting people and machines through mobile, cloud, and AI systems, and it describes its CTO as exploring shifts that make the network programmable, autonomous, and AI-native.

On AI specifically, the company says it is building trusted AI for networks and frames trust as the factor determining how far AI can go in telecom. It describes AI-driven tools for advanced 5G capabilities, network slicing, and orchestration, and it presents connectivity as a strategic advantage as AI moves into the physical world. The site also references AT&T's Open Radio Access Network transformation as laying the foundation for an open, disaggregated, and programmable network.

The company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000717826, and it also appears as ERICSSON (LM) TEL-SP ADR. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
